morphology.pattern_note: ber-...-an 在此表示许多东西分散各处的状态；词根 tabur 的辅音保留，词尾 r 与 -an 连接后划入末音节 ran。输入把派生词误标为词根；DBP 将其列于 tabur 词族。[DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bertaburan)

senses.zh_definition: 散落各处；零乱地散开，未按次序摆放。
senses.en_definition: To lie or become scattered about in a disordered state.
senses.ms_definition: Berselerak di sana sini, berhamburan dan tidak bersusun; berserak-serak.
senses.nuances: 侧重多个物件散乱分布的状态，可描述掉落后的结果；并不必然表示有人故意撒开。属于不及物表达，后面可接地点短语。[DBP 义项依据](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bertaburan)

senses.zh_definition: 大量分布于各处；星罗棋布地散布在某一区域。
senses.en_definition: To occur in large numbers at separate points across an area.
senses.ms_definition: Terdapat atau kelihatan dengan banyaknya di pelbagai tempat.
senses.nuances: 可中性地描述岛屿、星体或建筑的分布，不含第一义的凌乱或负面评价。[DBP 义项依据](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bertaburan)

dual_scenarios.ms: Pasukan pembersihan mengutip sampah yang bertaburan di sekitar tapak pasar selepas operasi tamat.
dual_scenarios.zh: 市场营业结束后，清洁队捡拾了散落在市场周围的垃圾。
dual_scenarios.en: The cleaning crew collected litter scattered around the market site after trading ended.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Kertas kau dah bertaburan kat lantai ni.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Kertas kamu sudah bertaburan di atas lantai ini.
dual_scenarios.zh: 你的纸都散在地板上了。
dual_scenarios.en: Your papers are scattered all over the floor.
spoken_features: kat 在此对应 di atas
kau、ni 是熟人间常用表达，分别对应 kamu、ini

messages.speaker: Amir (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Kertas kau dah bertaburan kat lantai ni. Kipas kuat sangat ke?
messages.ms_standard: Kertas kamu sudah bertaburan di atas lantai ini. Adakah angin kipas terlalu kuat?
messages.zh: 你的纸都散在地板上了。是不是风扇开太大了？
messages.en: Your papers are all over the floor. Is the fan blowing too hard?

messages.speaker: Hakim (室友)
messages.ms_spoken: Haah, aku nak kutip sekarang. Tolong tutup kipas jap.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, aku hendak mengutipnya sekarang. Tolong matikan kipas sebentar.
messages.zh: 对，我这就捡。帮我把风扇关一下。
messages.en: Yeah, I’ll pick them up now. Could you switch the fan off for a moment?

etymology.historical_story: Bertaburan belongs to the tabur family, whose meanings include scattering and sowing. The same spatial image connects seeds spread over ground, papers scattered across a floor, and islands dotted across the sea. Malay morphology turns that shared image into a word describing dispersed abundance, with disorder present in some contexts but absent in others. [DBP 词条](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=107200&keyword=bertaburan)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: tabur 是“撒”；想象撒出一把种子，满地都是——bertaburan 就是“散落各处”。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: 词本身语体中性，适用于新闻、报告及日常交流。描述他人物品时，直接说 barang awak bertaburan 可能带责备感，可加 mari kita kemaskan 来缓和。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: 用于垃圾或文件时常暗示需要整理；用于岛屿或星星时只是空间分布描写。不要把所有用例都译成“乱七八糟”。
